name: git-http
description: Make git speak HTTP/1.1 and abort a stalled transfer, machine-wide (git config --system http.version HTTP/1.1, http.lowSpeedLimit 1000, http.lowSpeedTime 60). Through bcproxy git's default HTTP/2 hangs a fetch forever once the tunnel is up, so units silently never updated (#220). Covers people (VS Code, shells) and verify-mast's own ls-remote; mast-clone sets the same values for its own process. Runs after git (700), which installs git.exe. always:true because a value changed out of band produces no payload-hash drift.
